name: Discount Moulding
old_description: At Discount Moulding, we specialize in providing high-quality interior doors and moulding at unbeatable prices. Whether you’re looking for baseboards, casing, or flat stock, our streamlined product selection makes it easy to find the right fit for your project. We keep things simple offering only what our customers truly need, without overwhelming options or inflated prices.
about:
Discount Moulding operates from its headquarters in Halethorpe, Maryland, with additional showrooms in Chicago, Charlotte, Baltimore, Tysons Corner, and Charleston. The company is family-owned, though its founding year and founders are not publicly disclosed.

The company specializes in interior doors and moulding, including baseboards, casing, crown, shoe, and flat stock. It purchases doors and moulding in truckload quantities and pre-hangs doors in-house, allowing customization of size, swing direction, jamb width, and hinge color. Discount Moulding maintains in-stock inventory across five showrooms, offering next-day pickup or delivery for many items.

Its customers include homeowners, builders, contractors, and designers working on residential and light commercial projects. The company has supplied materials for multi-unit apartment renovations and emphasizes service for both professional and DIY customers.

Discount Moulding differentiates itself through a volume-based purchasing model that enables discount pricing without compromising quality, combined with in-house pre-hanging for tailored door configurations. The family-owned business emphasizes honest advice, fast response, and personalized support.
